description: A display of what a Resonance Hub is doing, placed immediately to its left; it has no jacks
notes: click anywhere on the panel to move to the next page
the pages are Overview, Peers, Scope:Strips, Scope:Mix, Scope:Quad and Scope:Net
Overview gives connection, authentication and room state with a retry countdown; Peers lists who is connected with their device, latency and open channels
the three scope pages draw the CV going each way: one strip per person, everybody overlaid, and a four-channel grid; Scope:Net traces the seven values Net CV puts out
a Monitor placed anywhere but immediately to the left of a Hub prints a reminder to move it
